This is no ordinary flying enemy, its{{sic}} a lot bulkier then{{sic}} the rest!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 33 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Angel''' is a [[Flying]] enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. It is the second [[Flying]] enemy that appears in that mode, having higher health than the [[Fallen Seraph]] with the same speed. Additionally, it has [[Health Regen]], which causes it to regenerate 2% of its health every 2 seconds. ==Logbook Description== "''Fallen Angels were the kingdom's most devoted followers, blessed by Two X himself for their unwavering faith. They served as spiritual guardians, their presence bringing comfort to all who saw them. However, the Queen's sacrifice corrupted their blessings and tarnished their purity. As the curse consumed them, it became a symbol that their kingdom truly died.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Angel''' is an angel, hovering above the ground using its black wings. It wears blue armor which consists of a helmet, shoulder-pads, chestplate, leggings, shoes and gloves. It has a few crystals on its helmet. Above its head, it has a black halo. It has a hole in the middle of its torso. ==Strategy== *As the '''Fallen Angel''' is a [[Flying]] enemy, the number of towers that can target it is limited. **DPS towers that have flying detection, such as the [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are the best options against it. **The [[UAV]] can be used to give your towers flying detection, making the '''Fallen Angels''' quite easy to deal with. *Area of effect towers with flying detection, like the [[Mortar]], [[Tesla]] or [[Spotlight Tech]], can be useful at dealing with these, though due to this enemy's high health such towers may not be capable of killing this enemy on their own. **The [[Tesla]] can also be useful at slowing them down, giving your towers more time to kill them. *While the '''Fallen Angel''' does not have any immunities, it gains an immunity to being knocked back which is given by default to any [[Flying]] enemy. **This means that towers like the [[DJ Booth]], [[Brawler]] or [[Warlock]] are fully or partially unable to stall it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenAngelFly.gif|Flying animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenAngelStun.gif|Stun animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FallenAngel.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenAngel.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FallenFoesThumbnail.png|'''Fallen Angel''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Rocketeer Rework - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Angel''' on a promotional video.
